title: Admirals Trading
description: Admirals Trading LLC (admirals.ae) is a Dubai-based food and beverage company under the Saudi conglomerate Rashed Abdul Rahman Al Rashed & Sons Group, with over 20 years of experience in the UAE market, specializing in the distribution of 60+ international and local F&B brands, food manufacturing and processing, and third-party logistics services across retail, food service, van sales, and wholesale channels, having recently expanded its operations from the UAE into Saudi Arabia while also running an online store called "Buy Like Chefs."
